models_evaluated: neuro-symbolic AI (NSAI) system combining LLM extraction with symbolic reasoning

links.outcome: Agreement with adjudicated gold standard, NSAI versus trained human abstractors, on same reports
links.effect: NSAI kappa 0.95 versus human abstractors kappa 0.92 against the same adjudicated gold standard; NSAI matched or modestly exceeded humans.
links.quote: The NSAI system's agreement with the adjudicated gold standard (Cohen's kappa = 0.95) matched or modestly exceeded that of the trained human abstractors measured against the same standard (kappa = 0.92), with particularly strong performance on Gastrointestinal Metaplasia (CAP 43).

unlisted_practices: case-based refinement (iterative human-in-the-loop alignment of AI to real-world reports)
decomposing quality measures into atomic questions with symbolic reasoning to reduce variance across LLM backends

screen.reason: The study evaluates a neuro-symbolic LLM system for pathology quality measurement and performs component analyses testing specific engineering/deployment practices (case-based human-in-the-loop refinement and task decomposition) versus baseline LLM backends.
